test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'ANCIENT' is written as 'EPCIVPG' and 'ADVANCE' is written as 'XFCAGEP'. How will 'ABILITY' be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

First alphabet is placed at 3rd place and increased to 2 positional values.

Second alphabet is placed at 2nd place and increased to 2 positional values.

Third alphabet is placed at 1st place and increased to 2 positional values.

Fourth alphabet is placed at 4th place without any change.

Fifth alphabet is placed at 7th place and increased to 2 positional values.

Sixth alphabet is placed at 6th place and increased to 2 positional values.

Seventh alphabet is placed at 5th place and increased to 2 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e11b0462132bb0f6a014f9830de4413ece872e73f7f9bc0afc4b68c409f3a06.png] 

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b298a79b4850bfffcb5d60c751ecec08bff8053041e9ce9bc90cc93e0e09ee15.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e7f058a09049fb3b0055823f05272e6b37bf1e0e484200e2f547581a44053ef0.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**
